_comment: Placeholder triggers for attention, not advice. 'tilt' is what each triggered node does to the target mix (stocks, Treasuries, credit, cash; each tilt sums to zero). Tilts were written BEFORE any backtest and must not be tuned to flatter results. 'pit' says whether the metric can be used in a point-in-time backtest: ok, caveat (revised data), or exclude (history would leak the future). 'clear' adds hysteresis.

rules.message: Net liquidity fell sharply over 4 weeks
rules.action: Review risk budget; liquidity is draining faster than usual

rules.message: Net liquidity jumped over 4 weeks
rules.action: Liquidity tailwind; check whether it is Fed assets or a falling TGA

rules.message: Net liquidity fell over 13 weeks
rules.action: Persistent drain; revisit the neutral mix

rules.message: Treasury General Account rose by more than $175B in 4 weeks
rules.action: TGA rebuild pulls cash out of the system; watch funding markets

rules.message: VIX above 30
rules.action: Stress regime; consider the defensive end of your allowed range

rules.message: 10y minus 2y curve inverted
rules.action: Duration and recession-risk review

rules.message: Baa minus 10y spread above 3.0%
rules.action: Credit stress; review credit sleeve

rules.message: Chicago Fed financial conditions index in its tightest 5%
rules.action: Tight conditions; review equity and credit exposure

rules.message: St. Louis financial stress index above 0.5
rules.action: Stress building; check against VIX and credit spreads

rules.message: 10-year yield up more than 40bp in 4 weeks
rules.action: Rates shock; Treasury and credit duration review

rules.message: Broad dollar up more than 2.5% in 4 weeks
rules.action: Dollar squeeze can tighten global liquidity

rules.message: CPI inflation at or above 4% year over year
rules.action: High-inflation regime; see the 2022 replay in fedliq.py

rules.message: Core CPI running above 4% on a 3-month annualized basis
rules.action: Inflation momentum building; see the high-inflation replay in fedliq.py

rules.message: Core PCE (the Fed's gauge) above 3.5% on a 3-month annualized basis
rules.action: Raises the odds of a more hawkish Fed; review duration and liquidity exposure

rules.message: 5y5y forward inflation expectation above 2.75%
rules.action: Long-run expectations drifting up; the Fed is likely to respond

rules.message: Atlanta Fed GDPNow is negative for the current quarter
rules.action: Output contraction risk; compare with WEI and the Sahm indicator

rules.message: NY Fed Weekly Economic Index below zero
rules.action: Real-time activity weak; confirm against GDPNow

rules.message: Sahm recession indicator reached 0.5
rules.action: Has marked the start of every US recession since 1970; revisit the defensive range

rules.message: Chicago Fed activity index (3-month avg) below -0.7
rules.action: Historically elevated recession risk

rules.message: Real GDP more than 2% below CBO potential
rules.action: Large output gap; disinflationary, check policy response

rules.message: Liquidity model passed its out-of-sample significance test
rules.action: Model target weights may now differ from neutral; run allocator.py and read the diagnostics

rules.message: Model target weights are 5+ points from neutral
rules.action: Compare the model target with your current mix
